Windows Dynamic Lighting repaints the keyboard (Logitech LampArray Service), and its colours can stay on top of PulseBar until the keyboard is switched off. Turn the service off (services.msc → Logitech LampArray Service → Disabled) or Dynamic Lighting entirely, then switch the keyboard off and on. Turning it off for this keyboard alone does not last: after each reconnect Windows sees a new device.
